title: Child marriage in southern Germany: Over 350 cases recorded, some brides as young as 11
content: A written question by two AfD members of the Baden-Württemberg state parliament revealed 358 marriages involving minors, but only eight have so far been annulled with final legal effect.

title: Euronews tops rankings as fastest growing English-language news website
content: Euronews is the fastest-growing news website in the English-speaking world for the second month in a row, nearly doubling its audience as rivals shed readers.

title: EU sovereignty is ‘a need’ in the space, Sateliot CEO says

title: Could the European Security Council be the EU’s answer to hybrid attacks?
content: The European Commission proposed a new European Security Council (ESC) to respond to a recent surge in state-sponsored hybrid warfare, like cyberattacks and sabotage.

title: French Social democratic primary: Raphaël Glucksmann wins big in first round

title: Police clear Guano beach camp in Ceuta days before royal visit
content: Spain's National Police have cleared Guano beach in Ceuta, where about 400 migrants were still camped, two days before the King and Queen visit the city. It was the last remaining camp; some migrants fled to the nearby hills.

title: Nepal flash floods sweep away houses, five people missing

title: Russia strikes power plants in Ukraine despite 'energy ceasefire' announced by Trump
content: After Donald Trump's criticism blaming Volodymyr Zelenskyy for high diesel prices, suggesting Ukraine should get a new leader, US President announced Russia and Ukraine had agreed on an 'energy ceasefire', but Russia struck Ukrainian power plants hours after the announcement.
